name: Campaign Ad
description: I'm the Weather, and I approve this message.

storm.head: The Storm: Tough. Loud. Wrong for {city}.
storm.sub: Paid for by Citizens for Staying the Hell Inside.

storm.head: Thunder says it's fighting for you.
storm.sub: Thunder has never fought for you. Thunder fights everyone. Stay in.

storm.head: Storm: a record of destruction.
storm.sub: Downed trees. Lost power. Ruined picnics. Can {city} afford another Storm?

storm.head: The Storm has a temper problem.
storm.sub: Ask anyone who's met it. Stay inside. Paid for by Friends of Indoors.

storm.head: Lightning: shocking. Out of touch.
storm.sub: It strikes without warning. Vote Indoors.

storm.head: Thunder: all noise, no plan.
storm.sub: Loud, angry, and gone by morning. Sound familiar?

storm.head: Re-elect Basement.
storm.sub: Safe, dry, reliable. Paid for by Citizens for Staying Indoors.

snow.head: Snow promised you a white Christmas.
snow.sub: Now it's {temp} and slushy. Snow: all flake, no follow-through.

snow.head: Four more inches!
snow.sub: I'm the Snow, and I approve this message. You will not approve of your commute.

snow.head: Snow: cold. Distant. Flaky.
snow.sub: It said it would stop by noon. It lied.

snow.head: Vote Plow.
snow.sub: Plow: clearing the way for {city}. Paid for by Shovel PAC.

snow.head: Snow's plan: more snow.
snow.sub: No ideas. No vision. Just inches. Real boots this cycle.

snow.head: Snow promised a winter wonderland.
snow.sub: It delivered slush. Hold Snow accountable.

snow.head: Shovel: hard-working. Never quits.
snow.sub: A shovel in every garage. Vote Shovel.

snow.head: Blizzard: too extreme for {city}.
snow.sub: We need moderate weather, not more inches.

rain.head: Rain: soaking taxpayers since forever.
rain.sub: {pop}% chance. Can {city} really afford four more hours of this?

rain.head: What is Rain hiding?
rain.sub: Rain won't release its forecast. We did. It's {pop}%. Bring an umbrella.

rain.head: Rain: all wet on the issues.
rain.sub: {pop}% chance of the same old story.

rain.head: Umbrella: a candidate who covers you.
Rain promised change. It's just more water.
I'm Puddle, and I'm deeper than you think.
Rain: soaking you since forever.
rain.sub: Can you afford another day of this?

rain.head: Galoshes: the boot that gets things done.
rain.sub: Galoshes for {city}. Paid for by Dry Feet Now.

drizzle.head: Drizzle: weak on rain.
drizzle.sub: Can't even commit to a real downpour. Is that who you want leading your afternoon?

drizzle.head: Drizzle: never committed to anything.
drizzle.sub: Is it raining? Is it not? Drizzle won't say.

drizzle.head: Mist: flip-flopping all day.
drizzle.sub: Wet, then dry, then wet. Who can trust it?

drizzle.head: Drizzle: weak leadership.
drizzle.sub: Can't even rain properly. Is that who you want?

drizzle.head: Hood: covering you when nobody else will.

fog.head: Fog won't answer the tough questions.
fog.sub: Where are the roads? Where's the horizon? Fog has no plan. Headlights on.

fog.head: Fog: hiding something?
fog.sub: Visibility {vis}. What doesn't Fog want you to see?

fog.head: Fog doesn't show up to debates.
fog.sub: It just shows up everywhere else. Drive slow.

fog.head: Headlights: lighting the way forward.
fog.sub: Vote Headlights. Low beams, of course.

fog.head: What is Fog covering up?
fog.sub: Roads. Trees. Basically everything. Drive slow.

windy.head: Wind keeps changing direction.
windy.sub: North on Monday, southwest today. Gusts to {gusts}. You can't trust the Wind.

windy.head: Wind: blows hot and cold.
windy.sub: Gusts to {gusts}. Says one thing, blows another.

windy.head: Wind wants your hat.
windy.sub: And your umbrella. And your recycling. Don't let Wind win.

windy.head: Kite: rising above the competition.
windy.sub: On a day like this, only Kite thrives. Vote Kite.

windy.head: Wind blew it.
windy.sub: Wind at {wind}. Again. Time for calmer leadership.

scorching.head: The Sun says it's on your side.
scorching.sub: It's {temp}. Feels like {feels}. The Sun is lying to you. Get in the shade.

scorching.head: Heat: extreme. Dangerous. Out of touch.
scorching.sub: Paid for by the Committee to Re-Elect Air Conditioning.

scorching.head: The Sun's approval: melting.
scorching.sub: Feels like {feels}. Even its supporters are sweating.

scorching.head: Paid for by Friends of AC.
scorching.sub: {temp} today. Stay cool. Stay inside. Stay registered.

scorching.head: Shade: the coolest candidate in the race.

hot.head: Sunscreen. It's not partisan.
hot.sub: {temp} today. A message from Americans for Not Getting Burned.

hot.head: Summer: four more months?
hot.sub: {temp} and sticky. Is this the future we want?

hot.head: Ice Cream for {city}.
hot.sub: A cool choice for hot times. High of {high}.

hot.head: Sunscreen: protecting families.
hot.sub: UV {uv}. A message from Americans for Not Burning.

freezing.head: Winter wants another term.
freezing.sub: Feels like {feels}. Winter's record speaks for itself: frozen pipes, dead batteries, misery.

freezing.head: Winter: frozen in the past.
freezing.sub: Feels like {feels}. Winter's only plan is more of the same.

freezing.head: Vote Thermostat.
freezing.sub: Turn it up. A message from Citizens for Cozy.

freezing.head: Ice: dangerous. Slippery. Wrong.
freezing.sub: Low of {low}. Watch your step out there.

freezing.head: Frost: cold and calculating.
freezing.sub: It came overnight. It hid on your windshield. Shame.

cold.head: Cold: wrong on jackets, wrong for you.
cold.sub: High of {high}. Vote with your outerwear.

cold.head: Cold: on the wrong side of comfort.
cold.sub: {temp}. A jacket is the only candidate you can trust.

cold.head: Sweater: experienced. Reliable. Warm.
cold.sub: Sweater for {city}. I'm Sweater, and I approve this message.

cold.head: Cold: chilling our way of life.
Gloves: hand in hand with {city}.
cold.sub: Vote Gloves. Your fingers will thank you.

cold.head: Hot Chocolate: a sweet deal.
cold.sub: High of {high}. Paid for by Marshmallow PAC.

nice.head: It's morning in {city}.
nice.sub: {temp}, sunny, perfect. I'm the Weather, and I approve this message.

nice.head: Four more hours of this!
nice.sub: Real results for real people. Go outside, it's a mandate.

nice.head: A brighter tomorrow starts today.
nice.sub: Actually, today is bright already. Go outside.

nice.head: Promises kept.
nice.sub: It said it would be nice. It's nice. When was the last time that happened?

nice.head: This is what results look like.
nice.sub: {temp} and sunny. Paid for by the Committee to Re-Elect Today.

meh.head: Clouds: no vision. No plan. Just gray.
meh.sub: {temp} and nothing happening. Is this the leadership {city} deserves?

meh.head: Overcast: the status quo candidate.
meh.sub: Gray yesterday, gray today. Isn't it time for a change?

meh.head: Clouds took your sunshine.
meh.sub: And gave you nothing. {temp}. Paid for by Sunshine 2028.

meh.head: Gray skies have failed {city}.
meh.sub: No sun, no rain, no plan. Just {temp} and gray.

meh.head: Clouds: a decade of dullness?
meh.sub: Don't settle for overcast. Demand sunshine.

meh.head: Mediocrity is on the ballot.
meh.sub: Clouds want four more days of this. Say no.

clearNight.head: Tonight, the stars are out.
clearNight.sub: Unlike your candidate, they show up when they say they will. {temp}, clear.

clearNight.head: Moon: working the night shift for you.
Stars: everywhere, for everyone.
clearNight.sub: A clear night for {city}. I'm Night, and I approve this message.

clearNight.head: Stars: shining for everyone.
clearNight.sub: I'm the Night Sky, and I approve this message.

clearNight.head: Sleep: the bipartisan solution.
clearNight.sub: It's late. Clear and {temp}. Go to bed.
